summary: @servicetitan/titan-chatbot-client 2.1.8 preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package's preinstall hook runs setup.mjs, which is obfuscated with hex-name identifiers. On npm install it resolves a per-platform Bun binary URL under github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, downloads and extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it with math_init.js as the script argument (falling back to a pre-existing bun on PATH). math_init.js is a 727KB Bun-CJS bundle at the tarball root that is heavily obfuscated (string-array shuffle with a ~2000-entry numeric decode table, hex-named variables such as MmgoCP/etDiOOB/JqTtnbZ, `// @bun @bun-cjs` header). The declared purpose of the package is a React chatbot client UI; math_init.js is not referenced by the dist/ library surface consumers import, is not documented, and has no relation to the package's stated function. Using a separately downloaded alternate runtime to execute an undocumented obfuscated bundle at install time bypasses scanners that only follow Node-resolved edges. The behavior fires automatically on `npm install` for every installer of 2.1.8.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
